title: Chapter 742 - 742 15 Years Have Passed; He’S At The Overlord Level!
content:
Chapter 742 - 742 15 Years Have Passed; He’S At The Overlord Level!

Chapter 742 - 742 15 Years Have Passed; He’s at the Overlord Level!

742 15 Years Have Passed; He’s at the Overlord Level!

News of what happened at coordinate 5901 quickly spread throughout the universe, and many people started a heated discussion.

” Ocean Universe Master is dead!”

“That’s impossible, right? Isn’t he an Emperor level expert?”

“Impossible? Let me tell you, not only is the master of the ocean universe dead, but most of the great beings above king level and the main force of the ocean universe have all died!”

“Oh my god!”

“This… Could it be that the Holy Master has made a move?”

“It’s the mysterious Master of 5901!”

….

Dragon Tiger Sect.

All the disciples were very busy setting up array formations and refining weapons. They were very focused.

That was because they had learned from the universe news that the Ocean Universe Master had personally led an army to attack the Spring Field.

Although they had already left the Spring Region not long ago and came to the Autumn Region.

However, they felt that the peace in the Autumn Territory was only temporary.

When the ocean universe completely occupied the Spring Region, the Autumn Region might be next.

“Whoosh!”

At this moment, a stream of light flew over from afar.

A skinny man shouted,”” The ocean universe master is dead, and the ocean universe army has been destroyed. Don’t worry!”

” The ocean universe master is dead, and the ocean universe army has been destroyed. Don’t worry!”

” The ocean universe master is dead, and the ocean universe army has been destroyed. Don’t worry!”

He kept shouting, clearly extremely excited.

Hearing this, everyone looked up.

” Eldest Senior Brother?!”

Originally, they thought that someone was shouting for fun.

However, when they saw the skinny man’s face, they all cried out in surprise.

One had to know that Eldest Senior Brother had always been a serious person.

Now, he shouted like this…

Could it be…

Thinking of this possibility, many people’s hearts began to beat wildly.

At this moment, someone shouted into the communicator,””Look, look at the universe news!”

” Ocean Universe Master is really dead!”

“It was Star Lord 5901 who killed him!”

“Too strong!”

“That’s great.”

“Star Lord 5901 is too powerful!”

“He is the guardian of our Four Seasons Universe!”

….

Qin Qiuliang’s eyes were fixed on the cosmic news. He said excitedly,””Star Lord Lin, as expected of you!”

….

At the Watercloud Altar.

Ma Zheng was cultivating hard.

“Whoosh!”

At this moment, a puff of smoke flew in and condensed into a man in black tight-fitting clothes.

He knelt on the ground respectfully and said,””Greetings, Vice Altar Leader!”

“What’s the matter?” Ma Zheng asked.

“Important news regarding the ocean universe.”the man in the black tights said.

Ma Zheng had already instructed him to report to him as soon as anything related to planet 5901 happened.

That was because he knew that his master, Lin Fan, was the Star Master of 5901!

Ma Zheng’s expression changed slightly. He waved his hand and a scroll appeared in his hand.

The man in the black tight-fitting suit turned into smoke and disappeared again.

In the next moment…

Ma Zheng suddenly stood up and knelt on the ground. He said respectfully,”Master is invincible!”

After a long time, he slowly stood up.

Originally, Ma Zheng was still considering staying in the position of Deputy Altar Master for a while, waiting for the time to be ripe before making his next move.

Now, he felt that…Perhaps, he had to take another step forward as soon as possible.

Otherwise, he would be getting further and further away from Lin Fan.

He would be completely useless.

“Ah Da, Ah Er, Ah San!”

“Whoosh!”

Three balls of colorful light appeared below.

….

Fire God Palace.

Li Ke sat in the Sanctum of Sages, staring intently at his communicator.

His eyes flashed with excitement.

“Master is the strongest!”

“I can’t embarrass Master!”

Then, he closed his eyes and began to cultivate seriously.

….

Lin Fan had no idea what was happening in the outside world.

In the blink of an eye, 15 years had passed.

On this day…

“Phew!”

A strong gust of wind spread rapidly from the Coiling Dragon Villa in all directions and quickly swept across the entire Earth.

“Whoosh!”

Then, a golden pillar of light shot into the sky, as if it had covered the sky… Even the entire universe was penetrated in an instant.

The golden pillar of light continued to twist and condense.

Gradually, it turned into a huge golden dragon that bared its fangs and brandished its claws, covering the entire universe.

At this moment, countless living beings in the universe looked up at the golden dragon with great surprise and horror.

“Phew!”

Another strong gust of wind spread rapidly from the Coiling Dragon Villa. This time, it spread to the entire universe.

It was at this moment that Lin Fan, who was in a state of cultivation, heard a crisp notification in his mind.

[Ding! His cultivation level has increased to the Martial Monarch Realm.]

[Ding! [Congratulations, you have completed the hidden mission and your cultivation has broken through to the Martial Monarch Realm.] Obtained Transcendence Golden Body x10, Saint Crystal x5, Great Dao Fragment x2, Saint Weapon Gemstone x2, Saint Skill Gemstone x2.]

He felt the surging energy in his body and listened to the notification sound in his mind. The corners of his mouth curled up slightly.

This was definitely a great harvest!

After a while, he sighed again,” It took 15 years to break through. It’s a little too slow.””

Too slow?

If other people knew about Lin Fan’s words, who knew what kind of expression they would have.

How many people have been unable to break through a level of cultivation for hundreds of thousands of years?

How many people were unable to break through to the monarch level even after they died?

15 years, and you still think it’s too slow?

In order to express his dissatisfaction, Lin Fan cursed Bo Han who had 5 stars of hatred towards him.

Then, he used saint-tier gemstones on the True Dragon Sword and the Nine Mystical Robe respectively, allowing his attack and defense to reach a new level.

After that, he used a saint-tier cultivation technique gem on the Universe in the Palm and Sword 81, and his combat strength soared.

After doing this, he took the Great Dao fragments and Saint Crystals and jumped out.

In the blink of an eye, Lin Fan arrived at the bottom of the Path-Understanding Tree.

At this moment, Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others all stopped cultivating and focused their gazes on the villa where Lin Fan was.

Clearly, they were all attracted by the commotion caused by Lin Fan’s breakthrough.

“Lin Fan!”

“Hubby!”

Shouts rose and fell.

Lin Fan smiled and said,” I’ve made a breakthrough in my cultivation.””

When the girls heard this, they all smiled.

The person they liked had broken through. They were even happier than them.

After cultivating for 15 years, Lin Fan decided to relax with Hu Tian and the rest.

Hence, he decided to do it.

Today, a grand bonfire party was held in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Roasted meat, fine wine, fragrant fragrance, and laughter could be heard from time to time.

After the party, Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, and Xia Xue went to look for Lin Fan.

A month of hard work, a month of happiness.

Lin Fan returned to the villa and prepared to cultivate again.
